story_description: Implement the file system operations layer that downloads, validates, and installs registry items (skills, plugins, agents) to their appropriate CLI-specific directories with atomic operations, rollback support, and progress reporting.
task_description: Create the RegistryInstaller actor that handles downloading registry items from URLs, verifying checksums, extracting archives, and installing files to CLI-specific directories with atomic move operations and rollback on failure.
atom_description: Implement RegistryInstaller actor in Blaze/Sources/Registry/RegistryInstaller.swift providing async install/uninstall operations for SkillItem, PluginItem, and AgentItem types. Includes download with progress reporting via AsyncStream, SHA256 checksum verification, ZIP archive extraction, atomic file operations using temporary staging directories, rollback on partial failure, and CLI-specific installation path resolution for claude-code (~/.claude/skills/), gemini-cli (~/.gemini/plugins/), and codex-cli (~/.codex/agents/). Exposes InstallationState enum for UI binding and emits telemetry events for installation analytics.
problem_statement: Users need to install skills, plugins, and agents from the remote registry to their local CLI configurations. Without a robust installer, downloads may be interrupted, files may be corrupted, or partial installations may leave the system in an inconsistent state. The installer must handle network failures, disk space issues, permission errors, and provide clear progress feedback to the UI.

Telemetry events for install_started, install_completed, install_failed

assumptions: Registry items are distributed as ZIP archives at installUrl
ZIP archives contain a manifest.json at root with file layout instructions
Checksum is SHA256 hex string provided in item metadata
CLI config directories exist or can be created with standard permissions
User has write permission to CLI config directories
Download URLs use HTTPS and are reachable
Archive sizes are reasonable (under 50MB per item)
FileManager default instance is thread-safe for our use patterns
constraints: Must use actor isolation for thread safety
Must not block main thread during download or extraction
Must use only Apple frameworks (Foundation, Compression) no third-party deps
Must handle cancellation gracefully via Task.checkCancellation()
Must clean up temporary files on both success and failure
Must not exceed 100MB memory during extraction of large archives
Installation paths must be sandboxed to CLI-specific directories only
Must work offline for uninstall operations (no network required)
functional_requirements: FR-01: install(item:) async throws -> InstallationResult downloads item from installUrl to temp directory
FR-02: Download progress is reported via AsyncStream<InstallationProgress> for UI binding
FR-03: Downloaded file checksum is verified against item.metadata.checksum using SHA256
FR-04: ZIP archives are extracted using Compression framework to staging directory
FR-05: Files are moved atomically from staging to final CLI directory using FileManager.moveItem
FR-06: On any failure after partial file moves, rollback removes all installed files
FR-07: uninstall(item:) async throws removes installed files and updates manifest
FR-08: installationPath(for item:, cli:) returns correct path per CLI type
FR-09: installedItems() returns array of currently installed item IDs from manifest
FR-10: isInstalled(itemId:) returns Bool for quick UI state checks
FR-11: Concurrent downloads are limited to maxConcurrentDownloads (default 3)
FR-12: Installation can be cancelled via Task cancellation propagation
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR-01: Download of 10MB file must maintain 90%+ of available bandwidth
NFR-02: Extraction of 50MB archive must complete in under 10 seconds on M1 Mac
NFR-03: Memory usage during extraction must not exceed 100MB resident
NFR-04: All file operations must be atomic or rollback-safe
NFR-05: Telemetry events must fire within 100ms of state change
NFR-06: Actor must handle 100 concurrent install requests without deadlock

ui_states: Idle state: no active installation, install button enabled
Downloading state: progress bar shown with percentage and bytes transferred
Extracting state: indeterminate spinner with 'Extracting archive' label
Installing state: indeterminate spinner with 'Installing files' label
Completed state: checkmark icon, 'Installed' badge on item card
Failed state: error icon with message, retry button enabled
ui_interactions: User taps Install button -> install(item:) called -> state transitions begin
User taps Cancel during download -> Task cancelled -> state becomes failed(cancelled)
User taps Retry after failure -> install(item:) called again -> fresh attempt
User taps Uninstall on installed item -> uninstall(itemId:) called -> item removed
Progress bar updates in real-time during download via AsyncStream subscription
Error alert shown with localized message when installation fails

Failed - Checksum: 'File verification failed. The download may be corrupted.'
Failed - Extraction: 'Could not extract archive. The file may be damaged.'

edge_cases: Download interrupted by network loss mid-transfer must resume or fail cleanly
User closes app during installation must not leave partial files
ZIP archive with path traversal attack (../) must be rejected
Archive contains symlinks outside target directory must be rejected
Disk fills up during extraction must rollback and report error
Item already installed must skip download and return existing result
Multiple simultaneous installs of same item must deduplicate
Uninstall of non-installed item must return gracefully without error
CLI directory does not exist must create with appropriate permissions
Item installUrl returns 404 must fail with clear error message
Checksum field is nil in metadata must skip verification with warning log
Archive contains executable files must preserve execute permission bits
failure_modes: Network timeout during download - throw InstallationError.downloadFailed with underlying URLError
HTTP 4xx/5xx response - throw InstallationError.downloadFailed with status code in error
Checksum mismatch after download - throw InstallationError.checksumMismatch, delete downloaded file
Malformed ZIP archive - throw InstallationError.extractionFailed with Compression error
Disk full during extraction - throw InstallationError.insufficientDiskSpace, cleanup temp files
Permission denied on target directory - throw InstallationError.permissionDenied with path
FileManager.moveItem fails - throw InstallationError.installFailed, trigger rollback
Task cancelled - throw InstallationError.cancelled, cleanup any partial state
UserDefaults write fails - log error but do not throw, installation still succeeded
rollback_plan: If installation fails after files are partially moved to target directory, the rollback method iterates through installedFiles array and removes each file. If rollback itself fails (permission denied, file locked), log error with file paths for manual cleanup. Temporary staging directory is always removed in defer block. UserDefaults manifest is only updated on successful completion so inconsistent state is impossible.

notes: This atom is critical path for the onboarding experience - users cannot customize their CLI setup without functioning installation. The actor model ensures thread safety but requires careful consideration of cancellation and state management. File system operations are inherently risky so extensive edge case testing is essential.

risks: File system operations may fail silently on edge cases like case-insensitive filename collisions
Rollback may fail if files are locked by another process during cleanup
Large archives may cause memory pressure on low-RAM devices
Path traversal attacks in malicious ZIP archives could write outside target directory
Race condition if same item installed from multiple UI entry points simultaneously
mitigations: Use FileManager error handling with explicit error checking on every operation
Log rollback failures with full path details for manual cleanup instructions
Stream extraction to disk instead of loading entire archive into memory
Validate all extracted paths to ensure they resolve within target directory
Use actor isolation and track active installations to deduplicate concurrent requests
risk_register.blast_radius: Medium - installer writes to user's CLI config directories outside app sandbox. A bug could delete or corrupt user's existing skills/plugins/agents. However, rollback mechanism limits damage to single installation attempt.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If installer causes data loss, provide manual recovery instructions pointing to Time Machine backups of ~/.claude/, ~/.gemini/, ~/.codex/ directories. Add safeguard to backup existing files before overwrite in future version.
